# Mytour.vn

> Vietnam's leading online travel platform offering hotel bookings, homestays, corporate travel management, and custom tour packages with exclusive deals across Asia.

Mytour.vn is a comprehensive travel ecosystem operated by VNTravel Group, serving both leisure travelers and corporate clients. The platform provides accommodation bookings, event organization, gift cards, and specialized B2B solutions for business travel management across Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

## Key Topics

- Hotel Booking
- Luxury Accommodations
- Homestays & Villas
- Corporate Travel Management
- Business Expense Tracking
- SaaS Platform
- Travel Packages
- Flash Sales & Last-Minute Deals
- Budget-Friendly Options
- Vietnam Travel
- Destination Guides
- Gift Cards
- Event Organization
- Employee Booking System
- Cost Control Solutions

## Core Booking Services

- [Hotel Booking](https://mytour.vn/khach-san): Book 100,000+ luxury hotels and budget accommodations across Vietnam and Asia with guaranteed best prices
- [Homestays & Villas](https://mytour.vn/homestay): Discover and book vacation rentals, beachfront villas, and homestays throughout Vietnam
- [Mytour Mall](https://mytour.vn/mall/thuong-hieu-khach-san-hang-dau): Premium hotel brands with exclusive deals and luxury accommodations at special rates

## Corporate & Business Solutions

- [Mytour for Business](https://business.mytour.vn): SaaS platform for corporate travel management, employee booking systems, expense tracking, and financial reporting with VAT invoicing

## Travel Planning & Events

- [Mytour Event](https://event.mytour.vn/tour): Custom tour packages, event organization, and tailored travel itineraries designed to your specifications

## Additional Services

- [Mytour Gift Card](https://giftcard.mytour.vn): Digital gift vouchers for travel, hotels, and flights - perfect for gifting travel experiences

## Regional Hotel Guides

- [Hotels in Kiên Giang](https://mytour.vn/khach-san/khach-san-gia-tot/tp2/khach-san-tai-kien-giang.html): Hotel booking options in Kiên Giang with luxury and budget-friendly accommodation choices
- [Hotels in Hưng Yên](https://mytour.vn/khach-san/khach-san-gia-tot/tp8/khach-san-tai-hung-yen.html): Hotel booking options in Hưng Yên with luxury and budget-friendly accommodation choices
